Contests

[edit | edit source]
Main article: Starlyn Contest

Miria hosts a contest that takes place every SkyBlock Day and lasts for 20 real-life minutes. During the contest, a player can gain points through various means.

Shop

[edit | edit source]

Miria's Shop has 5 milestones, which are progressed by collecting  Miria's Coupons. Each contest awards a certain amount of  Miria's Coupons based on rarity.

Dialogue

[edit | edit source]
Condition Dialogue
After speaking to Helia
[NPC] Miria: Well nice to meet ya, <player>!
[NPC] Miria: About time you made your way to Torrhus Canyon, Agatha has told me all about you!
[NPC] Miria: So, now that you're here, are you ready to take on your next set of Starlyn Contests?
Select an option: [Let's do it!] [Maybe later]
Selecting [Maybe later]
[NPC] Miria: Gonna have a look around the island first? No problem! Toodles!
Selecting [Let's do it!]
[NPC] Miria: Great!
[NPC] Miria: Just so you know, my Starlyn Contests are partnered with the Critter Safari.
[NPC] Miria: What that means is, whenever you reach the UNCOMMON bracket or higher in one of my contests, you'll get a free Safari Ticket alongside your usual rewards!
[NPC] Miria: Show your ticket to the Safari Manager and he'll give you access to the Critter Safari for a limited time!
[NPC] Miria: I go there quite often - it's a pretty cool place where you can hunt dozens of  Critters to your heart’s content.
[NPC] Miria: The better your ticket, the more free stuff you'll get, so aim for the stars!
[NPC] Miria: #AD!
[NPC] Miria: So, with all that in mind, are you ready to take on my Starlyn Contests?
Select an option: [I sure am!] [I'll come back later]
Selecting [I'll come back later]
[NPC] Miria: See you around! Come back anytime!
Selecting [I sure am!]
[NPC] Miria: Come take a look at what my Starlyn Contests have to offer!
Reaching the MYTHIC bracket for the first time
[NPC] Miria: Huh? You reached my hidden MYTHIC bracket already? You're sure good at this Foraging business!
Reaching the DIVINE bracket for the first time
[NPC] Miria: Whaaat? You reached my hidden DIVINE bracket? Great job - keep it going!
Reaching the SPECIAL bracket for the first time
[NPC] Miria: You found my hidden SPECIAL bracket? Wow, my sister was right about you!
Abiphone Contact Holding an  Abiphone and intereacting with Miria before reaching the LEGENDARY bracket in her contest at least once.
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Nice to see ya!
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Hmm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Sure, I guess I can do that...
[NPC] Miria: ✆ But only if you reach the LEGENDARY bracket in my contest first!
Holding an  Abiphone and intereacting with Miria having already reached the LEGENDARY bracket in her contest at least once.
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Nice to see ya!
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Hmm, you want my Abiphone Contact?
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Sure, I guess I can do that...
[NPC] Miria: ✆ But only if you reach the LEGENDARY bracket in my contest first!
[NPC] Miria: ✆ ...
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Wait...
[NPC] Miria: ✆ You already reached it?
[NPC] Miria: ✆ HOW?
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Deal's a deal, I guess.
[NPC] Miria: ✆ Here's my contact.
[NPC] Miria: ✆ I'll give you a call whenever you finish a Miria's Contest so that you can claim your rewards.
[NPC] Miria: ✆ ...Or you can call me anytime to view my Shop!

Notes

[edit | edit source]
  • Miria will only keep your rewards from previous contests for one Skyblock year.

Trivia

[edit | edit source]
  • It requires  8,506 Miria's Coupon,  37 Miria's Prize,  2,148 Enchanted Helix Log and  286 Helixis to max out the Miria's Shop. It includes +2  Foraging Level Cap, Miria's Power, Miria's Personal Best and Helix Fortune perks,  64 Woodpecker Shard and  48 Vulture Shard, obtaining  LEGENDARY Sloth Pet,  Torrhus Artifact,  Enchanted Book (Petalfall V) and  2 Vial of Spring Water.
    • This comes out to a total of ??? coins if a player wishes to max out everything there.
